title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (manga)
subtitle: Hirohiko Araki
blurb: All 993 chapters in 140 volumes — nine parts, nine JoJos, one bloodline, still running.
notes: Nine parts, and the numbering restarts with them.

Shueisha ran the volumes 1–63 straight through Parts 1–5, then began each later part again at volume 1 — so Stone Ocean, Steel Ball Run, JoJolion and The JoJoLands each start over at Volume 1. Sections lead with the number on the spine and name the part; where the source also prints a cumulative number, the sub carries it.

Chapters run 1–594 across Parts 1–5, then start again at 1 for Stone Ocean, Steel Ball Run, JoJolion and The JoJoLands. Chapter 114 sits at the end of volume 12 here, where the Japanese volume prints it, rather than at the head of volume 13 where the English edition moves it.

The JoJoLands is ongoing, and this stops at volume 9 — the last one released. The generator asserts that count against the article, so the next volume fails the build rather than leaving the list quietly short. Rerun the pipeline to extend it.
The anime has reached Steel Ball Run.
The jojo list here is the David Production anime, which began adapting Steel Ball Run in 2026. JoJolion and The JoJoLands exist only as manga.

Volume boundaries and chapter numbers machine-read from the nine Wikipedia part articles that List of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure volumes transcludes, each volume checked to tile its part's chapters with no gap or overlap. Two unnumbered volume-exclusive Steel Ball Run extras carry no chapter number and are left out.
